description: This file defines two classes, AzureQueueDataAdapterV1 and AzureQueueDataAdapterV2, which implement the IQueueDataAdapter interface for serializing and deserializing queue messages for Azure Queue storage within the Orleans streaming framework. The classes handle conversion of stream events to queue messages and vice versa, supporting different serialization strategies for backward compatibility and custom serializers.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV1
classes.description: A data adapter for Azure Queue that maintains backward compatibility, does not support JSON or custom serializers, and serializes batch containers to base64 strings.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataAdapterV2
classes.description: A data adapter for Azure Queue that supports custom serializers like JSON, serializing batch containers to base64 strings.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts stream events into a base64-encoded queue message.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a base64-encoded queue message back into a batch container.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback invoked after deserialization to reinitialize the serializer using dependency injection.
